questions.q: What habit helped a Starbucks manager create the Frappuccino?
a: She bought her own blender and used it
She asked upper management for funding
She waited for a market study
questions.why: She bought her own blender and used it to make the drink.

questions.q: Why is leading by example more persuasive than giving orders?
a: People dislike being told what to wear
questions.why: People tend to follow visible actions more than verbal directives.

questions.q: What effect does empowering team members have on performance?
questions.why: Empowerment gives agency, boosting ownership and efficiency.

questions.q: Which leader's example is cited for modeling behavior?
questions.why: Steve Skarke is mentioned as a model of leading by example.

questions.q: What common pitfall do new leaders often repeat?
a: Adopting bad habits from past bosses
questions.why: Leaders often fall into the same pitfalls as ineffective past leaders.
